body: One bounded successor shape for chief consideration, not further review or scope authority: make Assessed store the nonempty eligible weight basis, not only eligible term names plus an independently supplied share. Derive measured terms from CostBreakdown terms minus imputedTerms; compute share from sorted normalized eligible weights; codec either omits share or checks an optional cached share against the derivation. Then no assessedFromWire caller-selected scalar exists, full/empty measured populations force 1/0, and the support estimand is explicitly relative to the carried configuration. Bare-private concrete construction plus same-package spoof refusal still required. If carrying weights is rejected, the honest alternative is a distinct ReportedSupportClaim on wire; do not promote it to derived Assessed. This does not fold in the separate total-overflow bead.
